_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The transcript keeps the bottom when a tool card replaces its placeholder. The test seeds a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose second, finished turn ends in a tall patch, so the page loads the patch as a completed tool card behind a placeholder (".tool-card-mount-placeholder--patch"). The page holds back IntersectionObserver reports about ".tool-card-mount-placeholder" elements until window.releaseToolCards() delivers them, which swaps the placeholder for the card. "The gap" is the messages container's (".messages-container") scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for an element ".tool-card-mount-placeholder--patch" to exist (allow 30s).
2. Wait until the gap is below 2 (an eval of gap < 2 expecting true).
3. The placeholder's offsetHeight must be greater than 2 (an eval of offsetHeight > 2 expecting true): without it the transcript would end above the current offset, the case that clamped.
4. In one async eval (no expect, it has side effects), on the messages container: record before = its scrollTop; call window.releaseToolCards(); await Promise.resolve() (Vue flushes on a microtask queued during the release, so the card is in place but no frame has run); record after = its scrollTop and mounted = whether the container contains a ".patch-tool"; store window.__swap = JSON.stringify({unchanged: after === before, mounted, scrolled: before > 0}).
5. window.__swap must be exactly {"unchanged":true,"mounted":true,"scrolled":true}.
6. Wait for an element ".patch-tool diffs-container" to exist.
7. Wait until the gap is below 120 (allow 15s).
8. document.querySelectorAll(".scroll-to-bottom-button").length must be exactly 0.

steps.expression: (async () => { const c = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); const before = c.scrollTop; window.releaseToolCards(); await Promise.resolve(); const after = c.scrollTop; const mounted = !!c.querySelector('.patch-tool'); window.__swap = JSON.stringify({unchanged: after === before, mounted, scrolled: before > 0}); })()
(() => { const mc = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); return mc.scrollHeight - mc.scrollTop - mc.clientHeight < 120; })()
